package parsers

import (
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ParseSortOptions parses sort options from query parameters with validation.
func ParseSortOptions(r *http.Request) *filters.SortOptions {
	sortField := r.URL.Query().Get("sort")
	sortOrder := r.URL.Query().Get("order")

	if sortField == "" {
		return nil
	}

	field := filters.SortField(strings.ToLower(sortField))
	order := filters.SortOrderASC
	if strings.ToLower(sortOrder) == "desc" {
		order = filters.SortOrderDESC
	}

	// Validate sort field
	validFields := map[filters.SortField]bool{
		filters.SortFieldCreatedAt: true,
		filters.SortFieldUpdatedAt: true,
		filters.SortFieldTitle:     true,
	}
	if !validFields[field] {
		return nil
	}

	return &filters.SortOptions{
		Field: field,
		Order: order,
	}
}
